name: What Leaves With Them
summary: For a team lead whose colleague is leaving: two agents answer a question about who owns what and why, from three company systems behind one Zetaris SQL endpoint; every claim cites a record id and a quoted line, and the Verifier re-reads that record at its source before the answer counts or is stored.
track: The Agent That Can Explain Why

agents.name: Investigator
agents.role: Answers from the memory graph with a fixed catalogue of 21 graph tools, backs the answer with citations (record id, quoted line, the claim it backs), and revises from the Verifier's notes. Must name a record that contradicts its answer.
agents.model_live: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B through Meterless Nightshift (app id wlwt-investigator, lane nemotron-lightning)
agents.model_sample_mode: none: the deterministic rule router of the pre-existing core

agents.name: Verifier
agents.role: Re-reads every cited record by id through Zetaris from the table of its own source system; the quote check cannot be overruled; then its own model judges whether the record as it reads now supports the claim. Rejects with notes and the record's current text; at most 2 revisions. Checks absences across all three systems with one UNION ALL query.
agents.model_live: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B through Meterless Nightshift (app id wlwt-verifier, lane nemotron-nano)
agents.model_sample_mode: none: the quote check runs; the model judgement is reported as skipped

write_gate: honest_memory/gate.py (pre-existing): an answer becomes a stored Finding only when every citation was accepted and no contradiction is left unaddressed

sponsor_technology.zetaris: The only data path to the three source systems: team chat in Postgres (JDBC), support tickets in a CSV file, documents behind a REST JSON API, registered in a local Zetaris 2.4.3.1 and read with Lightning SQL. The memory graph is built from three SELECTs through Zetaris; the Verifier re-reads each cited record by id through Zetaris and runs the absence query over all three sources. See zetaris_spike/README.md and open_agent/sources.py.
sponsor_technology.meterless_nightshift: Primary model provider: every model call of the agents goes to Nightshift on the same machine, serving NVIDIA Nemotron from local GGUF files; each response carries a receipt signed Ed25519 by the Nightshift daemon, and the client checks routed_model, the app's lane allowlist and zero cost on every call. See docs/METERLESS.md and open_agent/nightshift.py.
meterless_engines: H-MEM (reference implementation pinned in vendor/hmem, Apache-2.0): stores answers that passed the write gate as long-term memories, puts matching memories in front of the model before it answers, and turns the Verifier's verdict into feedback (helpful / not_helpful / wrong). See open_agent/hmem_bridge.py.
sponsor_technology.nvidia: NVIDIA Nemotron open models through Nightshift: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B for the Investigator (native tool calls), Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B for the Verifier (JSON verdicts). Receipt log: logs/receipts-wlwt-proof-20261024T115709Z-c6aed4.jsonl.
sponsor_technology.cursor: Not used for this build. The organizer said on 23 Oct 2026 that Cursor is optional; the project was written with other AI coding assistants under the author's direction.

data_sources: Synthetic company Quillfield Billing, generated by a seeded script with no network (python -m honest_memory.corpus --seed 42): 225 chat messages, 127 tickets, 51 documents
sample_data/sources/ (chat.tsv, tickets.csv, docs.json): the same three tables that load Postgres, the CSV table and the docs API
output_type: Run JSON: status (verified, absence_confirmed, no_claim, partially_verified, unverified, contradicted), answer, citations with source system, record id, quote and Verifier verdict, dropped citations with the reason, rounds, write-gate result, trace file
sample_mode: SAMPLE_MODE=true (the default in docker compose) runs the same agents, the same SQL text and the same write gate on sample_data/sources/ in an in-process SQLite; no model, no Zetaris, no credentials. It never reads output_examples/.
traces: logs/trace-<run_id>.jsonl, one JSON object per step, echoed to stdout
pre_existing: PRE-EXISTING.md: the honest_memory core (graph memory on FalkorDB, write gate, tools, router, benchmark, red team, panel) was built for Graph Hacks 15-18 Oct 2026 and imported unchanged at upstream a2cca9b; new in the window: zetaris_spike/, open_agent/, vendor/hmem, the packaging (docs/OPEN-AGENT-NEW-WORK.md, docs/METERLESS.md)
